text: The authors study easy-to-hard generalization with several human hardness measures (grade level, expert rating, required cognitive skills, question length, answer length and number of reasoning steps) plus a model-based minimum-description-length measure, across science QA, compositional reasoning and math reasoning datasets and multiple model sizes.
title: Human and model-based datapoint hardness measures for easy-to-hard generalization
